Hollis's message was a reminder to the channel, not a question, so I just replied in their thread in #central-team. I said I'd noted that expense reports are due Friday and offered to put a reminder on their calendar for Thursday. I didn't create the reminder because they haven't said they want one.

I checked GBrain first and found nothing about this expense deadline. That search was keyword-only, so it doesn't prove the notes have nothing on it.
